lines.en: I make my way out of the convenience store and try to spy on Yuki out of the corner of my eye- thinking that maybe she was just waiting for me to be gone to let her guard down and start crying or something.
Of course, I’m unable to see anything.
Not just because she’s likely not robotic enough to cease functioning the second I’m out of her line of sight, but because mine is currently being flooded by an onslaught of street lights and neon.
Yumi.
That’s what I should be thinking about right now- not whatever minor inconveniences I’m stuck dwelling on in an effort to make myself believe my problems are somehow bigger than hers.
After all, this is a rare opportunity for me to make a positive impact on someone’s life when they need it the most.
And oh, how excited I am to let that slip fall through my fingers like the grains of sand I’m still finding on my clothes and in my shoes all this time after the second beach trip.
If only I was able to bring something of value home with me rather than the useless remnants of something I never wanted to begin with.
Now, where did she run off to?
I look around and see plenty of other people.
And if this were one of those Korean dramas Ami watches all the time, I’m sure the first person I’d ask would know exactly which direction the girl I’m looking for ran off in.
Unfortunately, real life is scarcely that convenient- and I expect tonight to be full of failed chances at locating her amidst growing waves of uncertainty regarding whether or not I even should.
What can I do?
Or rather, what will I do?
Because those questions have two dramatically different answers, and the one that we’ll wind up observing together will likely be the one furthest from the right course of action.
Oh well.
I guess I’ll just shrug-
Slide my hands into my pockets-
And venture off in whatever general direction my gut points me in.
It’s led me to her plenty of times in the past.
Here’s hoping it doesn’t stop cooperating now.
Well, would you look at that?
There were barely any failures at all on the way here.
In fact, I think this is only the third or fourth alleyway I’ve had the displeasure of searching.
And here she is in all of her miserable glory- pounding away at a cement wall, still wearing the gloves her mother ridiculed her for not removing just a short while ago.
That’s good.
It might be awkward for all of us if I have to rush Yumi back to the convenience store for bandages only to find Yuki there, still caught up in a daze about where her life is heading.
: *Sniff*
: Fuck!
: Fuck! Fuck! Fuck!
: I know you’re there, asshole.
: Damn. I was a little interested in seeing if you’d be able to take down that wall or not.
: What gave my presence away?
: Probably the fact that my body instinctively tenses up any time you’re within ten feet of me.
: I’ll try and stay at least fifteen feet away the next time I have to chase you down an alley, then.
: How are your hands?
: I don’t know. Cold?
: They hurt a little, I guess.
: Not like I have anything else I can fuckin’ take my anger out on around here, though.
: And what the fuck were you doing with her?! I thought I told you to stop getting yourself involved with my fucking family!
: I’m aware. I have a tendency to kind of just do what I want, though, so commands like that won’t ever really have any effect on me.
: You don’t fuckin’ say.
: Since you’re being so polite, I guess I can let you know, though.
: I was helping her pass out fliers for the bar she works at.
: Probably so she can save up enough money for another present you can throw into Ayane’s pond.
: I don’t want her fucking presents. I want my childhood back.
: Let me know when she figures out how to fit that into a fucking box and I’ll think about maybe not dumping it into the nearest body of water.
: I’ll be sure to let you know.
: Yeah. Thanks.
: So, how long are you planning on staying out here for?
: In fact, why are you even all the way over here in the first place? We’re a long way from the dorms.
: So what? I’ve got legs. I know where the fuck I’m going.
: I’m pretty sure the last time I saw you over here, you were in the heat of trying to evade our constant run-ins with one another. Don’t tell me that’s what-
: I was looking for a job, okay?!
: Without my help? I didn’t think you cared that much.
: Well, I do! And since nowhere near the fuckin’ dorms wants to hire me, it looks like I’ve got nowhere else to search but right smack dab in the heart of the fuckin’ city!
: I really hope you weren’t planning on applying to that convenience store because I’m pretty sure you may have just ruined your chances.
: Ha ha ha. You’re fucking hilarious. Now can you leave me alone for a few more minutes so I can finish crying?
: Feel like that’s all I’ve been fuckin’ doing lately.

: You know, it’s real weird how I went basically my whole life without crying until you started getting involved in it. Now, it’s like I can’t even do shit without realizing how fucked up and weak I am.
: You should be thankful you met me now, then. That sort of thing would catch up to you after a while.
: And the longer you kept it held in, the worse it would be when it finally boils over.
: I’d sure as fuck be fine with takin’ my chances. Can’t see how it would be any worse than trying to beat a fucking cement wall to death.
: ‘Sides, wouldn’t all that shit about not bottling things up make you a hypocrite or whatever?
: That is, assuming you’re still capable of feeling anything and you’re not some...mindless fuck-robot.
: You know, at this point, that’s starting to sound like a pretty accurate description.
: Remember who it is you’re talking to, asshole. The second I have any confirmation you’re sticking your dick in anyone other than Chika, I’m tearing it all down.
: You could start by finishing that wall. A few hundred more punches and you’ll have likely made some sort of chip in it.
: *Sniff*
: Why me, man?...
: Why won’t everyone just leave me alone?...
I highly doubt Yumi wants me to actually answer that question- which is good, because I’d have no answer for it if she did.
I can’t speak for anyone else, obviously, but why do I keep bothering Yumi?
Is it really just to have sex with her?
Or is it more like I’m chasing after some sort of debt that I feel she’s owed after stealing her first kiss on a hill overlooking the homeless?
Or maybe it’s neither of those things?
Or maybe it’s both?
Maybe I’m just doing this because I feel like I’m supposed to?
Like neglecting her will, one way or another, cause my life to spiral out of control into a marathon of meaningless sex acts with all of her classmates.
That would have sounded wonderful several school years ago.
Actually, it sounds wonderful right now.
But, strangely enough, the presence of a girl who just wants me to leave her alone somehow brings a little balance to this thing of mine resembling a life.
And I’m talking about someone who actually wants me to leave them alone.
Even that part of Maya’s personality has been beginning to show cracks as of late.
But here’s Yumi- equipped with more cracks than you’d get from throwing a frag grenade at a china cabinet.
And here’s me-
Desperate to “fix” her.
Yumi stands up and shakes her gloves off before bringing them to her eyes to wipe away her tears, because god forbid I actually see them.
She stands still for a moment, torn between thoughts of running away again or actually talking to me.
If she does run, I won’t chase her this time. I know better than to go out of my way for someone twice in rapid succession.
But-
If she wants to talk-
I’ll do my best to soak up whatever overly-aggressive behavior or excuse she has for me this time around.
All while reminding myself that I can’t touch her, no matter how much I may want to.
: So...fliers? Really?
: This why you can’t be bothered to actually teach? You’re too busy workin’ night jobs with allegedly recovering addicts?
: Yes. I also fight crime by night, but you have to keep my secret identity to yourself or the two of us could be assassinated.
: Also, you should be thankful that I don’t actually teach because, if I did, you would have failed a long, long time ago.
: I’d be more interested in coming to school if I didn’t constantly feel like my teacher was imagining me naked.
: Don’t flatter yourself, Yumi. I have a whole twenty girls to imagine naked now. I only have so much time for you.
: Ew! Gross! Fuck off!
: See, this is exactly why I don’t show up! Because of you!
: Why not ask for a transfer then?
: To where? Everyone thinks I’m a fucking delinquent, dude. No one wants me.
: They don’t think you’re a delinquent. You literally are a delinquent.
: Well, yeah. That’s why they all think it. But that’s beside the point!
: I’m stuck in your stupid class, and unless you decide to throw me out of it, you’re stuck with me too.
: Just...only on days when I actually show up. The rest of the time, just pretend I don’t exist or some shit.
: You know I can’t do that, Yumi.
: But...why?
: All I do is cause problems and start shit with both you and the other girls.
: I’ve got what’s basically a negative attendance record, shit grades when I do take tests and, to top it all off, I’ve got mad fucking dirt on you from when you kissed me.
: Granted, nobody will fucking believe me if I tell them, but all of that should be enough for you to want to stay the fuck away.
: What?
: You just normally look a little...angrier when you say things like that.
: I’m done being angry for today.
: It’s giving me a headache.
: I just want to go home and go to sleep.
: What now?
: Is my sudden vulnerable side making you question your morals again?
: Are you going to make another horrible decision, Sensei?
: What if I close my eyes?
: How about now?
: Are you thinking about what you could get away with?...
: What sort of horrible shit you could do to me?...
: And how fucking easy it would be to overpower me when I’m so fucking weak right now!
Something pulls me under so quickly that I can’t even get a glimpse at what it is.
But, if I had to take a guess, it would probably look something like me.
I don’t know whether or not I’m blacking out right now, and I fear that whenever I snap out of this, I might find myself in a similar place to somewhere I’ve been in the past.
I can only hope this isn’t true-
But given the fact that Yumi’s already had a bad streak of luck today-
And the added fact that she’s been the target of these lapses in not just judgement but what seems like reality as a whole-
Well-
I can only imagine how things must be-
When I open my eyes, it’s as if nothing has changed at all.
Yumi is still standing there with tears pooling up behind her eyelids- though, several have managed to escape down the length of her cheeks.
And I’m still standing right next to her, caught somewhere between the early stages of forming an erection and the desire to slap her across the face and snap her out of whatever this is.
Two slaps in one night might be a bit too much for her, though.
And so I will use this moment as an excuse to reclaim several of the brownie points that I may have lost by being seen out in public with her least favorite person in the world.
: I’m not going to kiss you, Yumi. Chika is my woman and I am her loyal, monogamist man.
: Nothing's going to happen, Yumi.
: I'm not going to hurt you.
: Oh...Yeah.
: Yeah. Okay.
: Don’t tell me you were hoping I would...were you?
: O-Obviously not! In fact, I’m surprised you were able to hold back given how fucking...perverted and...insatiable you are!
: Right.
: Right! And why are you just standing there fuckin’...staring at me, you creep! Back the fuck off!
: You’re the one who walked up to me, Yumi.
: Jesus! When the fuck did it get so dark out here?! What time even is it right now?!
: Listen, as much as I’d love to stay and chat, I’ve got shit to do and...and it’s a long walk home.
: We can walk together if you want?...
: No.
: I’ll make it on my own.
Yumi leaves with that, and I’m forced to stand there in the alleyway and wait for her to fade away from my sight so as to not awkwardly walk behind her since we have to go in the same direction.
I’m not sure what really came over her with that “test” of hers a few minutes ago, but I’m thankful that it didn’t end in tragedy when nearly everything else tonight did.
I guess there’s nothing left to do now but...go home, then.
I decide to send Yuki a text on my way out of the alley, confirming that her daughter is, at least as of several minutes ago, still alive and doing mostly okay.
Yuki doesn’t respond.
I catch a bus back home and go the rest of the night without saying or thinking anything else.
Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!
